column4: A grown man waiting in a queue lets out one long weary bored sigh through his nose and mouth, no words, a tired heavy exhale. Close, indoors in a small shop, dry recording.
A grown man impatiently huffs out a short annoyed breath and clicks his tongue once, no words. Close, indoors in a small room, dry recording.
A grown woman waiting in a queue lets out one long weary bored sigh, no words, a tired exhale ending in a soft hum of annoyance. Close, indoors in a small shop, dry recording.
A grown woman impatiently huffs out a short irritated breath through her nose, no words. Close, indoors in a small room, dry recording.
A bored eight year old boy waiting in a queue groans a long whiny bored sigh, no words, the exhale dragged out. Close, indoors in a small shop, dry recording.
An old grandmother waiting in a queue lets out a long tired creaky sigh and a small disapproving tut, no words. Close, indoors in a small shop, dry recording.
